title: Using language models to label clusters of scientific documents

live_model.evidence: "ChatGPT4 (gpt-4o-2024-05-13), and ChatGPT4o (gpt-4o-2024-11-20)" (Sec. 4); Table 4 Plant Biology, ChatGPT4 mean cosine similarity 0.969 vs the ChatGPT4o baseline

prompt.location: Table 2 (prompt template and clauses) and Sec. 4 (system prompt)

claim.metric: mean cosine similarity of generated cluster labels to the gpt-4o-2024-11-20 baseline (Plant Biology)

data.source: Clusters of publications from the Dimensions bibliographic database (proprietary), four Fields of Research

notes: The metric is relative to labels produced by gpt-4o-2024-11-20 (not in the live list) plus an embedding model; the document clusters come from Dimensions and are not released. Number of clusters per field is not stated in the extracted passages.
